subject: Gumroad API publication and buyer delivery
prior_claim_retracted: Connecting one payout method makes creation, publication, and delivery zero-owner-action through the API.

official_sources.title: License keys - Gumroad Help Center
official_sources.supports: The official FAQ says creating products or uploading content with the API is not possible.

official_sources.title: Things not allowed on Gumroad
official_sources.supports: A product with no buyer content that directs buyers elsewhere to obtain it is blocked; files, video, or written content must be attached.

official_sources.title: Adding a product
official_sources.supports: Product content and license-key placeholders are configured on the product content page, and publication follows buyer-view testing.

official_sources.title: Testing a purchase
official_sources.supports: Creators can use Gumroad's test-purchase flow without charging their own card to verify buyer access.

fail_closed_rule: Do not enable a paid Gumroad product until the finished ZIP is attached as buyer-accessible Gumroad content and the test-purchase download succeeds.

preferred_immediate_revenue_path.reason: The existing account already has a publicly verified automatic-download product; the completed 38,000 JPY kit requires one listing operation and no new payout integration.
